text.title: This week's weather in Greenhaven
text.subject: Erste lebende Fremdsprache
text.text:
THIS WEEK'S WEATHER IN GREENHAVEN
Your five-day forecast - plan your week and enjoy it!

Monday: sunny, 21 degrees C
Tuesday: cloudy, 17 degrees C
Wednesday: windy, 15 degrees C
Thursday: rainy, 13 degrees C
Friday: sunny, 22 degrees C

Don't forget your umbrella on Thursday!
It is a little cool in the middle of the week, so take a warm jacket.

WEEKEND OUTLOOK
Saturday and Sunday look warm and sunny. A perfect weekend to be outside!
Have a lovely week, Greenhaven. See you next Monday for a new forecast.

annotations.label: What is the weather like on Wednesday, and how warm is it?
annotations.answer: It is windy on Wednesday, and it is 15 degrees C.

annotations.label: You want to have a picnic in the park. Which day is best, and why?
annotations.answer: Friday is best. It is sunny and 22 degrees C, the warmest day of the week, so it is perfect for a picnic. Monday is also good (sunny, 21 degrees C).

annotations.label: What should you wear and take with you on Thursday? Explain why.
annotations.answer: Take an umbrella, because it is rainy on Thursday. It is also cool (13 degrees C), so wear a warm jacket too.

annotations.label: Write a short message to a friend (3-4 sentences). Suggest a good day this week to meet outside, and say why (use the weather and the temperature).
annotations.answer: Modelltext: "Hi! Let's meet on Friday. It is sunny and 22 degrees C, so it is a great day to go to the park. See you then!" (3-4 kurze, korrekte Saetze; ein Wetterwort und eine Temperatur aus dem Text; Vorschlag mit Begruendung).

annotations.label: Work in pairs. You are two friends. Use the forecast to plan one activity for the weekend.
annotations.answer: Erwartet: A begruesst und macht einen Vorschlag ("Let's...", "Why don't we...?"), begruendet mit dem Wetter (warm and sunny); B stimmt zu ("Good idea!", "That sounds great"), schlaegt eine Aktivitaet vor und fragt nach dem Tag ("Saturday or Sunday?"); beide einigen sich auf einen Tag. Nuetzliche Wendungen: "What do you think?", "How about...?", "Let's meet on...".
roles: You are friend A. Greet your friend. Say you want to do something together at the weekend. Look at the weekend outlook and suggest going to the park. Say why (warm and sunny). Ask your friend what they think.

You are friend B. Greet your friend. Agree that the weekend looks good. Suggest one activity for warm, sunny weather (for example a picnic or a bike ride) and ask which day - Saturday or Sunday. Agree on a day.
